title: objectql: the unserved knowledge_source boot warning says "it is loaded, indexed or searched" for one item (missing negation), and its test pins the wrong text
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Filing gate: ① follow-up of PR #38059 (#38039; out-of-scope finding of the dev report 7230969358, class a) · Source: topic #37000
Grading: area:ai · Bug · p3 (suggested: a boot warning states the opposite of the fact for one item) · reach: any boot that holds exactly one `knowledge_source` and no knowledge service · evidence: read on main 27ee98438e — `packages/objectql/src/knowledge-source-unserved.ts:43` renders `${count === 1 ? 'it is' : 'none is'} loaded, indexed or searched`; `knowledge-source-unserved.test.ts:20` pins `'it is loaded, indexed or searched'`.
Dedupe: `is:issue describeUnservedKnowledgeSources` → checked at filing; none open.
Reader: area o1-C of seat repo:objectstack#1 claims it after triage's first touch.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：部署里只有一个知识源、又没装知识服务时，启动警告写成"它会被加载、索引或检索"，意思正好说反了（多个时的"都不会"是对的）；测试还把这句错话钉住了。
- 做什么：改成"它不会被加载、索引或检索"，并改正测试。
- 谁受益：看启动日志排查知识检索的运维和作者。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
In `describeUnservedKnowledgeSources`, the singular arm must read "it is not loaded, indexed or searched". Correct the pin in `knowledge-source-unserved.test.ts` to the negated text, and assert the singular line does not contain the un-negated phrase.

## Acceptance
- The one-item line says the item is not loaded, indexed or searched; the plural line is unchanged.
- The test pins the negated singular text and goes red on the old text.
